title: Binary serialization of a machine
statement: For a finite-state two-tape machine code with $n+1$ states, define its binary serialization by encoding $n$ in binary and pairing that code with a binary list consisting of the initial state followed by the encoded transition actions. The transition table is listed in increasing state order, and for each state in the order of the three possible input symbols (blank, false, true), the three possible symbols on the first work tape, and the three possible symbols on the second work tape.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state two-tape machine code
caveat: The definitions of the pairing, state, and action encodings are not supplied, so the exact binary format cannot be specified.
